newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's convertible bond issues rise 27.7 pct.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's convertible bond issues rise 27.7 pct.

text.p: South Korea's issues of convertible bonds as of July 29 this year were up 27.7 percent to 931.8 billion won from 729.5 billion a year earlier, the Korea Stock Exchange said on Wednesday.
The exchange said about 2.07 trillion won worth of convertible bonds were traded so far this year, compared with 1.1 trillion won worth traded for the whole of last year.
Trading of such bonds was expected to increase to 3.5 trillion won this year, it said.
